final: WITH station_averages AS (SELECT o.observstation, o.lunarstage, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusage, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM observatories AS o JOIN telescopes AS t ON t.observstation = o.observstation GROUP BY o.observstation, o.lunarstage), phase_totals AS (SELECT lunarstage, AVG(avg_bandusage) AS avg_bandusage, SUM(telescope_count) AS telescope_count FROM station_averages GROUP BY lunarstage) SELECT lunarstage, avg_bandusage, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS telescope_fraction FROM phase_totals
